en.hubeali:
Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Suleyman, from the one who mentioned it, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding the Words of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic
[2:45] And seek Assistance with the patience, heasws said: ‘The patience (is a reference to) the Fasts’.

And heasws said: ‘When there descends upon the man the descending (afflictions) and the difficulties, so let him Fast, for Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic is Saying [2:45] And seek Assistance with the patience, Meaning the Fasts’.
en.sarwar: 7. Ali has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Sulayman from those whom he has mentioned who has said the following: “This is about the words of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Glorious,

Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘“Patience” is a reference to fasting.’ He further said, ‘If a man faces severe difficulties, he should fast. Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Glorious, has said, “Seek support through patience,” that is, “fasting.””’
